request.style: English, Latin worship salsa, piano montuno, congas, timbales and bongos, a bright trumpet and trombone section, bass tumbao on the clave, joyful female lead with a coro answering, 98 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
I was dressed in sackcloth
Sitting in the dust
But you came and lifted me
You turned it all around

[Chorus]
You turned my mourning into dancing
You clothed me with joy
My heart will sing your praise
And not be silent

[Verse]
Take away my sorrow
Put the music in my feet
Lord, my God, I thank you
Forever I will sing

[Chorus]
You turned my mourning into dancing
You clothed me with joy
My heart will sing your praise
And not be silent

[Bridge]
Baila, baila, dance before the Lord
I will thank you forever

[Chorus]
You turned my mourning into dancing
You clothed me with joy
My heart will sing your praise
And not be silent
